story.iWant: to create an account using my email address
story.soThat: I can access personalized analytics and save my preferences

tasks.task: Implement email validation with RFC 5322 standard (AC: #1) - Create Zod schema for email validation using RFC 5322 regex pattern - Integrate email validation into registration form - Add real-time email validation feedback (on blur or while typing) - Test: Verify email validation rejects invalid formats and accepts valid ones - Test: Verify validation feedback appears in real-time

Implement password validation and strength meter (AC: #1) - Create password validation schema: minimum 8 characters, 1 uppercase, 1 number, 1 special character - Build password strength meter component with visual indicators (weak/medium/strong) - Implement real-time password strength calculation - Add password requirements helper text - Test: Verify password validation enforces all requirements - Test: Verify strength meter shows accurate feedback

Create registration form with ShadCN/UI components (AC: #1, #2) - Use ShadCN/UI Form components with react-hook-form integration - Implement email, password, and confirm password fields - Add real-time validation feedback for each field - Implement loading state (button disabled, spinner shown) during submission - Ensure form follows design system (Competitive Data theme colors, responsive layout) - Test: Verify form accessibility (keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility) - Test: Verify form works on all responsive breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px)

Implement account creation API endpoint (AC: #1) - Create POST /api/auth/register endpoint - Validate request body using Zod schema - Hash password using bcrypt with salt rounds ≥10 (or use Supabase Auth password hashing) - Create user record in database via Prisma - Set default user role to "USER" - Test: Verify password is hashed before storage - Test: Verify duplicate email addresses are rejected - Test: Verify API returns appropriate error messages

Implement email verification flow (AC: #1) - Generate secure verification token (32+ characters, URL-safe) - Store verification token in database with expiration (24 hours) - Send verification email via SMTP/email service with confirmation link - Create email verification confirmation page - Create API endpoint to verify token and activate account - Redirect to email verification prompt page after registration - Test: Verify email is sent successfully - Test: Verify token expires after 24 hours - Test: Verify account activation works correctly

Implement error handling and user feedback (AC: #2) - Create error mapping service for user-friendly error messages - Display field-specific error messages below relevant fields (red, 14px font size) - Ensure error messages are clear and actionable - Keep fields focused for correction after validation errors - Handle network errors gracefully - Test: Verify all error scenarios display appropriate messages - Test: Verify error messages meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements

Integrate with NextAuth.js authentication system (AC: #1) - Configure NextAuth.js for email/password authentication - Integrate registration flow with NextAuth.js session management - Ensure compatibility with existing authentication infrastructure - Test: Verify registration creates valid session after email verification - Test: Verify session persists across browser tabs and devices

Accessibility and responsive design compliance (AC: #1, #2) - Ensure form meets WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance - Add proper ARIA labels to all form fields - Verify keyboard navigation works correctly - Test screen reader compatibility - Ensure responsive design works at all breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px) - Test: Verify accessibility compliance using @axe-core/playwright - Test: Verify responsive design on real devices

criteria.given: I am on the registration page
criteria.when: I enter a valid email address and password that meets requirements
criteria.then: - Validates email format using RFC 5322 standard - Validates password meets requirements: minimum 8 characters, at least 1 uppercase letter, 1 number, 1 special character - Displays password strength meter with visual feedback (weak/medium/strong indicators) - Shows real-time validation feedback for each field - Displays loading state during account creation (spinner overlay or button loading state) - Creates the account successfully and sends email verification - Redirects to email verification prompt page - Stores password securely using industry-standard hashing (bcrypt with salt rounds ≥10)
- Error messages appear below the relevant field (red, 14px font size) - Error messages are clear and actionable - Fields remain focused for correction

docs.doc: FR1: Users can create accounts with email or social authentication. Includes requirements for email validation, password security, and account creation flow.
NextAuth.js 4.24.12 for authentication handling and session management. Supabase Auth for OAuth providers. Cookie-based sessions with secure HTTP-only cookies.
Prisma ORM 5.0.0 for type-safe database access. PostgreSQL via Supabase. User model defined in prisma/schema.prisma with email, name, role, and authentication fields.
Zod 4.1.12 for schema validation throughout the application. Used for email, password, and form data validation.

ShadCN/UI (New York style) components configured with Competitive Data theme. Form components with react-hook-form integration. CSS variables for theming (Deep Indigo #4f46e5, Cyan #06b6d4, Purple #8b5cf6).
Mobile-first approach with breakpoints: 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px. Touch-optimized interactions for mobile devices.
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required. Keyboard navigation support. Screen reader compatibility. Color contrast ratios meet WCAG standards (minimum 4.5:1).

Complete story definition with acceptance criteria and technical notes. Use NextAuth.js, Zod schema for validation (RFC 5322 regex pattern), password hashing via Supabase Auth or NextAuth.js with bcrypt, email verification flow with secure tokens.
Design system available with CSS variables, ShadCN/UI components, icon system, responsive utilities, animation system, accessibility testing framework established.

ideas.idea: Test email validation with RFC 5322 standard: Test valid emails (standard, plus signs, dots), invalid emails (missing @, invalid domain, special characters), edge cases
Test password validation: Minimum 8 characters enforced, uppercase letter required, number required, special character required, all requirements combined
Test password strength meter: Weak passwords show weak indicator, medium passwords show medium indicator, strong passwords show strong indicator, real-time updates as user types
Test real-time validation feedback: Email validation shows feedback on blur, password validation shows feedback while typing, field-specific error messages appear immediately
Test loading state: Button disabled during submission, spinner shown during account creation, form fields disabled during submission
Test account creation: Successfully creates account in database, password is hashed before storage (verify hash format), default role set to "USER", duplicate email addresses rejected
Test email verification: Verification token generated and stored, verification email sent successfully, token expires after 24 hours, account activation works on token verification
Test redirect flow: Redirects to email verification prompt page after registration, verification prompt page displays correctly

Test error messages: Error messages appear below relevant fields, error messages in red color, error messages in 14px font size, error messages are clear and actionable, fields remain focused for correction
Test accessibility: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance, keyboard navigation works, screen reader compatibility, ARIA labels on all form fields, focus indicators visible
Test responsive design: Form works at 320px breakpoint, form works at 768px breakpoint, form works at 1024px breakpoint, form works at 1440px breakpoint
Test NextAuth.js integration: Registration creates valid session after email verification, session persists across browser tabs, session persists across devices
